name: foldrender
description: Publish an HTML page as a link that opens on any device, put several pages on one canvas, and read FoldRender pages, comments and answers back as text.

interface.longDescription:
Turn an HTML page you made with Codex (a report, a diagram, an explainer, a dashboard) into a link that opens on a phone, a tablet or a computer, and choose who can see it. Put several pages on one canvas with notes and connectors, ask the reader to answer a question with a tap, and read pages, comments and answers back as clean text.

The plugin runs the foldrender command on your computer, so it needs a local Codex session with a shell; it installs the command from foldrender.dev when it is missing. Pages are stored by FoldRender under your account, which you sign in to with GitHub. Pages are private unless you share them.
capabilities: Publish an HTML page as a link
Read a page back as text
defaultPrompt: Publish report.html as a private link I can open on my phone.
Put these three pages on one canvas and give me the link.
Read the comments people left on my FoldRender page.
